title: Grocery store job and learning violin, mandolin and guitar
summary: He clerked in the one grocery store and learned violin, mandolin and guitar by ear, playing Sunday nights near an oyster factory.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
